## CG Oncology to Present at the TD Cowen 46th Annual Health Care Conference


Feb 23, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.cgoncology.com/node/8176/pdf)


IRVINE, Calif., Feb. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CG Oncology, Inc. (NASDAQ: CGON) today announced that Arthur Kuan, Chairman & Chief Executive Officer, and Ambaw Bellete, President & Chief Operating Officer, will present at the TD Cowen 46th Annual Health Care Conference on Monday, March 2, 2026, at 3:10 pm ET. The conference is taking place at the Boston Marriott Copley Place in Boston, MA.


Interested parties may access the live audio webcast for this conference from the[Investor Relations section](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V5m3NWBx1mqeR1UaUg7ODhtoNn5X6uVOX5DdAAXr1ZHnCyzJ0B09N3Xxo_aj85_4nJLJTpJPkQ5bDTsFhbpq6riJBLuu1DalQnD1DhwXmqUdhjsado5DCvx394n09mHNymxRkDFEBngaQ0SqS3ZWHi03yMiCjDWa7HGgYlAPSkyk6esUj6-VBxz1oWi3X11Rx_jrHa2QDau-1_Iye8Wzw7zIaxceXVjB6qHdL6vnEl6L4UhOIzhVtMaa53_TG2-exxoMw1jNVhenxH51XrPLuA==) of the company's website at[www.cgoncology.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_t4TuGjqc0r67pDXToEIH95_arp2hdnUWYZT6jJFE6epjJQ8QR4UJAyQjFSwkZitdGI3uNA_LTEL3fNS06Yn1I4VHE4N11NilHKY1EPXiPYtBAeQXY0O9xYG26chtvZUfBTDgTe2pNfs9xzbDb-MAchtviVMA3hgQjmzQPWOweQhi3t09jBZogxWdk0dilWJU0n8AoYbP6wNFIPM4zxJm3B7CnesZNBv2H1AQEgAGs2eyfqwTizBvHi9t_9LoCRa9R7oXD_WFiU5EawV4Nbb4g==) . The webcast replay will be available shortly after the conclusion of the live presentation and archived for approximately 90 days.


**About CG Oncology**
CG Oncology is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing a potential backbone bladder-sparing therapeutic for patients afflicted with bladder cancer. CG Oncology sees a world where urologic cancer patients may benefit from our innovative immunotherapies to live with dignity and have an enhanced quality of life. To learn more, please visit:[www.cgoncology.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_t4TuGjqc0r67pDXToEIH5dyF1IVRIVZ1KC006gddE0_hlSe0r8kvH5n9k9SkpnQC2RIP7QWhASPsmKXUgFoxSfkQxyMrxb-pz8NGbUg2Tc=) .
